verdict.rationale: Exporting all your data in open formats is a fair question for accounting SaaS, but the evidence documents no full-account export feature. The APIs, OpenAPI spec and SDKs are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not the capability itself. The bank payment-file export is an adjacent, narrow feature, and the QuickBooks migration service moves data into Xero, not out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
